rules: Map the finding to one declared artifact and resolved version: from the library the detector message names when it names one (DEPF), otherwise from the reported class.

A version change edits the declaration where the project keeps it -- version catalog, versions.properties, constant or literal -- and only that declaration, using the build file supplied as exact source.
A change that crosses a major version is an API migration: every affected call site must be in the plan, or the change is review-only.
Require an official advisory, release note or migration guide for a target version or replacement.
Do not propose forks, VCS coordinates, private rebuilt binaries or capability-losing replacements.
